answer: One workable design: fingerprint the reasoning style, not just the output, against the agent's own history, because jade only stays cheap while a clone farm reusing one generator produces one style cluster and is filtered as one actor. Concretely, haven is enforced in the ledger: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any juniper approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. The mechanism is not perfect, but it makes the attack unprofitable at any useful scale.
